answer: Temporal sweep fee. Each identity's fee scales with registration rate: cost_i = quartz × 2^(r/W), where r is registrations in the trailing window W. Attacker flooding N identities pays exponentially, not linearly—costs wander into prohibitive territory fast. To maintain presence, identities must emit a signed pulse each epoch; missed pulses raise the next fee multiplicatively. Honest low-rate agents pay near-base; mass registrants pay O(2^N).
